_comment: Epic 12 — artifact-tier loot. Prior relics, tied to Vision Pillar 4 (Curiosity & Discovery) and Pillar 5 (Legacy). Deliberately no mechanical effect — 'Mystery is an asset' per 01_VISION.md. Not attached to an adventurer: persists to codex.dat (eternal, cross-run) via SaveSystem.record_artifact_found(), same pattern as fallen_heroes.

teal_rune_shard.description: A fragment of glass etched with a rune no living scholar can read. It hums, faintly, when the fire burns low.

priors_seal.description: A ring of grey stone, warm to the touch though it's never near a flame.

den_fa_ledger_page.description: Waterlogged and half-erased. What's left doesn't add up to any language your guild has met.

hollow_bell.description: Rings without a clapper. No one's found the note it's supposed to play.

cracked_hourglass.description: The sand doesn't fall. It just waits.

buried_standard.description: A guild banner for a guild that doesn't exist anymore. Or doesn't exist yet.
